description: Canoeing teaches you to paddle safely and efficiently: hazards and first aid, the parts of a canoe and paddle, life jackets, carrying and launching, capsize recovery and rescues, and tandem and solo strokes and maneuvers.

safety.note: Paddling activities follow Safety Afloat and require a qualified supervisor; Scouts must pass the BSA swimmer test.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Excerpts showed the safety, equipment, handling, rescue and tandem-maneuver requirements but not every number, so only the confirmed opening requirement is outlined. Check the official list for numbering and distances.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Hazards and first aid
requirements.summary: Hazards of canoeing and how to respond, and first aid for injuries such as blisters, hypothermia, heat reactions, sunburn and sprains.
